title: What has Emmanuel Lubezki been up to recently? Is he semi-retired?

commenti.body:
I follow him on instagram and he still occasionally posts stuff. I think he’s waiting for another film
From Alejandro innaritu. He’s bound to make another big one soon enough . Similar to revenant / bird man. Or the other director who did gravity

> Or the other director who did gravity

Alfonso Cuarón
They shot a TV series together which will be on its way fairly soon.

>What's he up to

He won the Oscar for Best Cinematographer 3 years in a row, so I'd guess he's up to whatever the f he wants these days. 


I also love the guy, his camerawork and use of natural light were one of the only reasons I watched that Malick trilogy as many times as I did. 

I'd guess he's taking a break and mostly just spending time with his family. I don't think he's going to take *just any* project in the future, it will most likely be something personal (maybe write/direct himself) or something one of his friends makes. Either way, also looking forward to it.

He's cashing in by working in commercials. Pays a lot better and is a lot less stressful than working in narrative:

[https://wp-a.com/clients/emmanuel-lubezki#commercial](https://wp-a.com/clients/emmanuel-lubezki#commercial)

Very similar to how Wally Pfister became a commercial director after Transcendence flopped instead of going back to being a cinematographer. Makes a lot more money with a very cushy lifestyle.

He’s the cinematographer for Alfonso Cuaron’s miniseries Disclaimer starring Cate Blanchett which will premiere some time this year on Apple TV+. Cuaron is directing 5 out of 7 episodes. Not sure how many episodes Lubezki is making because Bruno Delbonnel is also a cinematographer for the miniseries so most likely they split episodes up between them.

[Source](https://www.worldofreel.com/blog/2023/9/27/y6jnvgl84yldmyzhhl3e4gm8ottgjs)

One of the coolest moments; gonna share.

I learned this after doing a camera prep, and walking down the street in NYC, I ran into Bruno Delbonnel. As a DP, I don’t think he’s suuuuuper recognized in person… but I stopped him and just wanted to say “hi, big fan, good to see you.” He asked me to walk down the street with the him, and just was down to talk! So fucking nice. I asked how work was, and if he’d been staying busy, and he was just leaving a color session with Cuaron and Chivo for this show. I was like “holy fuck no shit?” And he was just gracious and amazing.

I was high on that for days
That makes sense! I've heard commercials are where it's at.
